profile.name: Amrit Dash
headline: I am Amrit Dash,
an AI & Automation Engineer
building intelligent workflows
and delightful products.
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 5 years of experience implementing automation projects. Worked as a consultant on Cash Application Automation for 2 years. I prioritize real-world applications over textbook problem-solving with a fail-first, fix-fast mindset. Outside of work, I perform stand-up comedy and chase good food and new adventures.

experience.description: Driving end-to-end automation of student onboarding, class allocation, attendance tracking, and parent-student communication using Make.com, Zapier, n8n, and Google Apps Script with core CRM operations on Monday.com.

Flutter Developer at CDT Koraput (Coffee Mapper). AI Engineer at BeGig building a custom LLM chatbot with RAG. Shopify developer for Kunsquad. WhatsApp bot developer for Nothing Bot Comedy spot curation in Bangalore.

Built automation scenarios for manual business processes using Make, Zapier, Apps Script, and Zoho. Delivered end-to-end employee onboarding, appraisal, and offboarding automations with ongoing optimization for cost efficiency.
Built Apps Script Automation Projects (ASAP) tools adopted company-wide for project management, team management, and faster data gathering for consultants.
Implemented CAA projects for Zurich Insurance, CrediQ, Heritage Crystal Clean, and Bureau Veritas. Managed resources and delivered live client implementations after co-op training.
